# JSpecify annotations 1.0.0

`jspecify-1.0.0.jar` is the unmodified Maven Central artifact
`org.jspecify:jspecify:1.0.0`, used by the sample javac gates.

- Upstream: https://github.com/jspecify/jspecify/tree/v1.0.0
- Artifact: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/jspecify/jspecify/1.0.0/jspecify-1.0.0.jar
- SHA256: `1fad6e6be7557781e4d33729d49ae1cdc8fdda6fe477bb0cc68ce351eafdfbab`
- License: Apache 2.0, reproduced in `jspecify-LICENSE`.

Receiving projects supply their own JSpecify dependency. The existing JetBrains
annotations jar remains available for the explicit `--annotations jetbrains` mode.
